name: Snapdrop
short_description: Local network file sharing inspired by Apple AirDrop.
description: Snapdrop is a self-hosted local network file sharing tool. Transfer files between devices on the same network with no accounts, no plugins, and no configuration. Works in any modern browser. Inspired by Apple AirDrop for cross-platform use.
usecases: Transfer files between your phone and computer instantly on the same network.
Share documents between devices without cloud services or USB cables.
Send files to guests on your local network without any apps or accounts.
